terms.sec5_p1: All prices on the website are displayed in Algerian Dinars (DZD). Shipping fees are calculated at checkout based on your wilaya and selected delivery option. We make every effort to ensure accurate pricing; in the event of an obvious typographical error, we will contact you to confirm the correct price or cancel the order without obligation.

privacy.meta_description: Learn how your personal data is collected, used, and protected in our store following the highest security and transparency standards.
privacy.page_subtitle: We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the confidentiality of your personal information while shopping with us.
privacy.sec1_p1: We recognize the critical importance of your personal data and are committed to handling it with the utmost responsibility and transparency. This policy outlines what information we collect when you visit or make a purchase, how it is used, and how it is secured. We never sell or rent your data to unauthorized third parties.
privacy.sec2_p1: When using our store, registering an account, or placing an order, we collect only the data necessary to provide our services:
privacy.sec2_li1: Full Name: to process orders, generate invoices, and issue shipping labels.
privacy.sec2_li2: Phone Number: for order confirmation and direct coordination with courier delivery agents.
privacy.sec2_li3: Email Address: to send order confirmations, digital receipts, tracking notifications, and password reset links.
privacy.sec2_li4: Shipping Address (Wilaya, municipality, street): to ensure accurate and timely delivery to your doorstep or pickup point.
privacy.sec2_li5: Order history, shopping cart items, and wishlist preferences: to manage your account and personalize your shopping experience.
privacy.sec3_title: 3. Purpose of Processing and Using Data
privacy.sec3_p1: Collected data is used solely for legitimate business purposes:
privacy.sec3_li1: Processing, fulfilling, and delivering customer orders safely and promptly.
privacy.sec3_li2: Communicating order updates, shipping tracking information, and answering customer support inquiries.
privacy.sec3_li3: Managing personal user accounts and streamlining future shopping experiences.
privacy.sec3_li4: Improving website performance, service quality, and optimizing product offerings.
privacy.sec3_li5: Preventing fraudulent activity and safeguarding transactions for all users.
privacy.sec4_p1: We do not sell your personal data. We only share data with essential service providers necessary to fulfill your orders:
privacy.sec4_li1: Authorized Courier Companies: sharing recipient name, phone, and address to facilitate package delivery and cash collection on COD orders.
privacy.sec4_li2: Authorized Payment Gateways (Chargily Pay): processing online debit/credit payments (Edahabia / CIB) within an encrypted, PCI-DSS compliant environment without storing your card numbers.
privacy.sec4_li3: Legal and Governmental Authorities: only when required by applicable law or a valid court order from competent authorities.
privacy.sec5_p1: Our store utilizes necessary cookies and local storage to deliver core website functions:
privacy.sec5_li1: Session and Remember-Me Cookies: to keep you securely signed in and avoid re-entering credentials upon each visit.
privacy.sec5_li2: Cart and Wishlist Storage: to preserve selected products across page reloads and browsing sessions.
privacy.sec5_li3: Display and Language Preferences: to remember your chosen store language (Arabic/French/English) and dark/light mode preference.
privacy.sec5_p2: You can manage or disable cookies via your browser settings; however, disabling them may affect cart functionality and account access.
privacy.sec6_p1: When enabled by store administration, we may use analytics and marketing tools (e.g. Facebook Pixel, TikTok Pixel, Google Analytics) to measure advertising effectiveness and understand visitor engagement. These tools collect pseudonymized or encrypted data, and you may block them using privacy extensions in your browser.
privacy.sec7_p1: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, including customer support, warranty fulfillment, and legal and accounting compliance. Data is securely deleted or anonymized once retention periods expire or upon account deletion request.
privacy.sec8_p1: Every user possesses comprehensive rights concerning their personal data:
privacy.sec8_li1: Right of Access: inspect and review all stored personal information and past order records via the account dashboard.
privacy.sec8_li2: Right of Rectification: update or correct any outdated or inaccurate name, phone, or address information at any time.
privacy.sec8_li3: Right of Erasure: request permanent account closure and data deletion from our servers by contacting customer support.
privacy.sec9_p1: We implement advanced security measures including HTTPS/TLS encryption for all data in transit, firewall-protected database servers, robust password hashing (BCrypt), and strict role-based access controls limited to authorized staff.
privacy.sec10_p1: If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or your personal data, please contact us:
